quote.text: You don't get paid for activity. You get paid for closed deals. 27 leads and zero closes means the gap is the conversation you haven't had yet.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls booked. Check GHL/Calendly for any weekend bookings, then run a personal follow-up pass on every unbooked lead. Sunday is a slow inbound day — make it an outbound day.
focus: Capital One's 'payments returned' notice from Friday is still the only real fire in the inbox, and it's now 2 days old. Log into Capital One today and confirm whether that card funds your $35/day Meta spend, then clear the returned payment. A declined card silently pauses delivery and kills your only live lead channel — don't let it ride into a third day.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at ~$17 CPL — that's roughly $460+ spent on people who never booked, and zero prospect replies in the last 48 hours. Run a personal text-and-call blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link. Lead volume is fine; the only lever left is follow-up speed and reps.

Confirm today's FB ad is delivering at ~$35/day and that the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 groups. With no closes yet you can't afford a silent delivery failure burning budget, and the group posts are your only free top-of-funnel while outbound is paused.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours. The one item that still matters: Capital One's 'Action required: payments returned' from Friday (sent twice) — resolve it against the card funding FB Ads before delivery is affected. Minor: a new Google review came in for Clear View Exterior Cleaning (worth a quick reply). Everything else is routine personal noise — NYT crossword, a telehealth-portal forms reminder, jewelry support, a $5 Zelle, FIFA tickets, Skool, LinkedIn jobs, and Upswing poker. Nothing needs a business reply.
